entries.text: - <change that needs a human decision>
entries.note: 템플릿 자리표시. 호출이 아님

entries.text: ## Human decision requests
entries.note: 제목

entries.text: | Human decision required
entries.note: 표 머리

entries.text: Human decisions require concrete options and a reason evidence alone cannot decide; missing advice is triage, not a human requirement.
entries.note: 사람 결정 경로의 형식 계약(U 경로 자체의 정의)

entries.text: INCONCLUSIVE never implies a human decision: agent evidence recovery and human choices are separate blocker routes.
entries.note: 설명

entries.text: <bounded blocker summary; Human decision requests, Needs triage, Evidence recovery; local artifact path remains plain text>
entries.note: 자리표시

entries.text: If every merged opinion is missing for reviewable groups, seal stops without a verdict; the documents-only/source-dirty path may still seal INCONCLUSIVE from worktree evidence.
entries.note: 도구 동작 설명. 행동 지점은 C8 (?)

entries.text: Human requires humanReason plus 2–5 distinct options; agent recovery needs evidence, not a human choice.
entries.note: 사람 결정 요청의 형식 제약

entries.text: When the brief's section reports `truncated > 0`, record the missing claims as an evidence gap; do not recover them from the human Change Context table.
entries.note: "human" = 사람이 쓴 표. 호출 아님

entries.text: If a present PR has a missing or empty base name and no explicit `--base`, run `node <skill-directory>/../pull-request/scripts/resolveBaseBranch.mjs --project-root <session cwd>` and use its JSON `baseRef` as `--base`; stop with its diagnostic only when it exits nonzero or reports `ambiguous: true`.
entries.note: C2 draft applied: an empty PR base is resolved by resolveBaseBranch.mjs; the remaining stop is an ambiguous or unresolvable base, U(b).

entries.text: - With `--cleanup`, call `review_state({ action: "cleanup", projectRoot: PROJECT_ROOT, confirm: true })`, report `cleaned`, and stop.
entries.note: 설계된 정상 종료

entries.text: Stop on group-budget errors: report diagnostics and the explicit restart option without dispatching actors or publishing a verdict; never auto-force them.
entries.note: U(c). Only the group budget still stops the run for a person; state diagnostics now mean one prepare.

entries.text: Report the verdict, review completeness, human-decision requirement and agent next action from the sealed comment.
entries.note: 출력 항목 설명

entries.text: Only a user's explicit budget change may raise it; `--force` never bypasses it.
entries.note: U(c). Raising the group budget is the user own spending decision.

entries.text: `summary.reviewComplete=false` means more evidence work remains, not that a human must decide.
entries.note: 사람을 부르지 않는다는 설명

entries.text: - `--cleanup`: delete only this branch's review directory, then stop; default off.
entries.note: 설계된 종료

entries.text: Do not ask the user to resolve agent-owned evidence gaps.
entries.note: 금지문

entries.text: Continue only when `status: ok` and `summary.disposition: sealed`; otherwise report diagnostics and stop without a terminal verdict.
entries.note: S5b가 `facts-discrepancy` 분기로 바꿈(스펙 §10). 그 밖의 비정상 seal은 §10의 "seal 비정상 반환"(판정 대상)

entries.text: Human requires a reason evidence alone cannot choose and 2–5 distinct nonblank options of 1–300 chars.
entries.note: 형식 제약

entries.text: Report reviewComplete, human-decision requirement and agent next action from the sealed comment.
entries.note: 출력 항목

entries.text: `approve` continues; `modify` removes or narrows items and re-presents the plan; `cancel` ends without writes.
entries.note: 사람이 고른 종료

entries.text: Two findings are deferred instead of repaired: a `stale-path` whose token matches a `structure.generatedPaths` entry (the path exists at runtime; whether the rule should exempt it is a config decision), and a `missing-field` on a Boundary Exemption whose `Reason` is empty (the reason is a human claim, never generated).
entries.note: 생성 경로 면제 여부·경계 면제 사유는 설정·제품 결정

entries.text: <!-- [INTERACTIVE] -->
entries.note: 문서 편집 승인(설계된 상호작용)

entries.text: `--dry-run` displays the plan and ends without writes.
entries.note: 설계된 종료

entries.text: Report: Show the script output to the user
entries.note: 결과 보고

entries.text: Report the output to the user.
entries.note: 결과 보고

entries.text: Uses a cross-platform Node script for batch processing — the LLM only reads the script output and reports to the user.
entries.note: 결과 보고(결정 위임 아님)

entries.text: The LLM executes the script and reports the output to the user.
entries.note: 결과 보고

entries.text: The user re-runs the skill with `--execute` to apply the migration; no inline confirmation prompt is issued from this skill (the explicit `--execute` flag is the gate).
entries.note: Describes how the user invokes the skill; the skill calls nobody.

entries.text: If the script is not found, abort with an error message.
entries.note: 플러그인 설치 결함

entries.text: | `INCONCLUSIVE` | Stop. Evidence could not settle the question; a resolve run would act on unsettled findings. |
entries.note: 초안: "`INCONCLUSIVE` → carry out the sealed comment's agent next actions (evidence recovery), then re-run `/filid:pipeline`; stop only when the blockers are human decisions." (?)

entries.text: | Dirty source worktree | Stop. Report the abort message verbatim. |
entries.note: dirty worktree(옛 U)

entries.text: Stop and report success.
entries.note: 정상 종료

entries.text: | Typecheck failure with every correction reverted (`--auto`) | Stop. The failure predates the corrections; `resolve` repaired or reverted each one it could. |
entries.note: C39 draft applied: resolve repairs at most twice and reverts only the corrections it cannot repair; the remaining stop is a failure that predates the corrections (designed termination).

entries.text: Never stops the pipeline.
entries.note: 부정

entries.text: **Omitting `hasPullRequest` reads as "no PR".** A branch that already has an unreviewed PR then enters `pr-create` instead of `review`, where the existing-PR overwrite confirmation stops the run for input — the one place this pipeline yields by accident.
entries.note: 호출을 피하라는 설명. 실제 호출은 C44

entries.text: Document sync never stops the cycle — its findings ride in the PR body's `FCA Handoff`, and `review` reads the body's handoff block and top sections as change context.
entries.note: 부정

entries.text: Stage outcomes that stop the pipeline:
entries.note: 제목

entries.text: Forwarded to `pr-create`; `--no-push` turns it off — `pr-create` then saves the body and the cycle stops there |
entries.note: 호출자가 고른 종료

entries.text: Never stops the pipeline; its verdict is the pipeline result |
entries.note: 부정

entries.text: Stop condition |
entries.note: 표 머리

entries.text: Record for a human or configuration decision |
entries.note: 설정 결정

entries.text: On exit 1, report stderr and stop; never substitute another base.
entries.note: C41과 같음. 옛 M(`pull-request/reference.md:48`)은 U로 제안 — 추정이 모호할 때 고를 근거가 없음 (?)

entries.text: If the batch call fails, its artifact cannot be read, or `data.results` is missing after that fallback, append `{ class: "document-sync", ruleId: "document-sync", path: ".", note: <diagnostic verbatim> }` to `HANDOFF_ENTRIES`, set `Document sync: failed`, leave the owner set empty, skip step 4, and proceed to step 7.
entries.note: Failure handling inside the skill; the finding it appends is machine work, not a hand-off.

entries.text: Caller inputs — read every `--issue`, `--spec`, `--decision`, `--screenshot`, `--focus`, and `--notes` value and preserve the normalized result as `INPUTS` through Stage 3.
entries.note: Names the inputs the calling agent passes; "caller" here is the agent, not a person.

entries.text: 3. <!-- [INTERACTIVE] --> An existing PR requires an explicit overwrite confirmation before its body is replaced.
entries.note: 파괴적 덮어쓰기 동의

entries.text: A `documents-only` worktree can carry user edits, so `documents-only → all RICH → commit success` reports `committed`.
entries.note: 설명

entries.text: A nonzero exit stops with its diagnostic and the §1 base-resolution message.
entries.note: exit 1 사유: detached branch, base 앞선 커밋 없음, 추정 불가. 근거 없는 base 선택(§1 메시지가 `--base` 지정을 안내) (?)

entries.text: abort with §1 |
entries.note: dirty worktree(옛 U)

entries.text: Reject-the-rejection cases, reported back to the developer for a second pass:
entries.note: U(a). The interactive resolve sheet sends a rejected rejection back to the person who wrote it.

entries.text: Interactive only: use AskUserQuestion once per batch round with exactly two fixed options:
entries.note: 설계된 결정표

entries.text: <!-- [INTERACTIVE] AskUserQuestion: batch decision sheet -->
entries.note: 설계된 결정표

entries.text: Abort — no review to resolve.
entries.note: 같은 칸에 "Run `/filid:cross-review` first" — 다음 행동 있음

entries.text: Abort — the source moved since the review.
entries.note: "Re-run `/filid:cross-review`" — 다음 행동 있음

entries.text: - interactive → report and stop before committing;
entries.note: 상호작용 모드의 사람 판단(`--auto` 갈래는 C39 쪽)

entries.text: If it fails with every correction reverted, the failure predates this run: abort with `Typecheck failed before applying fixes.`
entries.note: Designed termination: the tree did not compile before resolve, so no correction can be judged (C39).

entries.text: `--dry-run` prints this material and ends without changes.
entries.note: 설계된 종료

entries.text: Preserve unrelated working-tree changes and stop on a partial operation instead of silently inventing a recovery plan.
entries.note: restructure 부분 실행 복구(옛 U)

entries.text: Stop when the envelope is non-`ok` or the plan contains unresolved moves.
entries.note: 이어지는 문장이 "follow nextAction" — 결정 이유별 판정은 소스 쪽(`describeDecision.ts`)

entries.text: End without a verdict and record that the baseline cannot be reconstructed after the fact. |
entries.note: Designed termination of a standalone revalidate (S6 ruling C54).

entries.text: End without a verdict and record that `resolve` has not run. |
entries.note: Designed termination of a standalone revalidate (S6 ruling C63); revalidate does not run resolve itself.

entries.text: Incomplete analysis never implies a human choice: report recoverable evidence as agent work, and human decisions only with concrete options and a reason.
entries.note: 설명

entries.text: If still pending, return the URL and stop because the user interaction has not completed.
entries.note: 사람이 연 설정 화면(설계된 상호작용)

entries.text: - `--rules`: run project initialization and managed-rule settings only, then stop before snapshot inspection
entries.note: 설계된 종료

entries.text: If `--rules` is present, emit the managed-rule summary and stop.
entries.note: 설계된 종료

entries.text: Run from an installed filid plugin, where the host sets CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, or reinstall the plugin, then retry; report to the user if it persists.
entries.note: CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT unset / plugin not installed; reinstall is outside the agent's reach.

entries.text: Ask the user to make .filid/review-rules.json and its rule files regular files inside the repository.
entries.note: Spec: repairing review config during a review gets source protection, so not freely M; replacing a symlink may also undo an intentional share.

entries.text: Ask the user to reinstall or update the filid plugin, whose installed cross-review actor files are incomplete, then retry the same call.
entries.note: Incomplete plugin installation; reinstall/update.

entries.text: Ask the user to make the named review directory writable, or to move it aside, then call prepare again; filid cannot change file permissions.
entries.note: Directory permissions are outside the agent: filid cannot make a read-only review directory writable (V2).

entries.text: Ask the user to correct the named review setting in the filid config, then retry the same review_state call.
entries.note: Spec: config repair during a review is protected; groupChurnLimit/maxGroups are the user's spending bounds.

entries.text: Ask the user to reinstall or update the filid plugin, whose installed cross-review rule files are incomplete, then retry the same call.
entries.note: Incomplete plugin installation; reinstall/update.

entries.text: Ask the user to reinstall or update the filid plugin, whose installed cross-review rules.json is malformed, then retry the same call.
entries.note: Corrupt plugin installation; reinstall/update.

entries.text: Ask the user to reinstall or re-enable the filid plugin and restart the session so its MCP server receives the plugin root, then retry the same call.
entries.note: CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT unset / plugin disabled; reinstall, re-enable, restart session.

entries.text: Stop without dispatching actors or publishing a verdict.
entries.note: Stop half of the installation next actions in rows 7, 8, 9, 17; the same string names the next action (reinstall, retry), so not a dead end.

entries.text: Pass confirm: true to cleanup only after the user explicitly agrees to discard this branch's review artifacts, then call again.
entries.note: Explicit consent to discard review artifacts; the gate itself.

entries.text: If no base resolves, ask the user for an explicit base ref; never substitute the repository default.
entries.note: Comparison base with no evidence after the mechanical fetch; the sentence forbids substituting a default. Refinement: try the PR's baseRefName before asking.

entries.text: Ask the user to fix .filid/review-rules.json as the message describes.
entries.note: Spec: repairing review config during a review gets source protection, so not freely M.

entries.text: Stop without dispatching actors and ask the user to split the PR or raise review.maxGroups in .filid/config.json; unset, the limit is filid's own default of 64 rather than a number the user chose.
entries.note: U(c). The sentence now names review.maxGroups in .filid/config.json and says the unset limit is filid’s own default of 64 (S6 ruling A12/R10).

entries.text: Do not report the review as complete while it remains; ask the user to fix or remove the named key in the filid config.
entries.note: Spec: config repair during a review is protected; blocks reporting completion.

entries.text: If the same diagnostic returns in this run, end without a terminal verdict and record it in the report as a filid defect.
entries.note: R-2 designed termination shared by every unusable-state diagnostic (PREPARE_ONCE_NEXT_ACTION).

entries.text: Otherwise, with the user's consent, replace ${} with the real file or directory, or move it out of the project.
entries.note: Replacing or moving a symlink is a structural change the user may have made on purpose; the preceding exclude option is already the agent's own action.

entries.text: With the user's agreement, make a fractal own ${} — an INTENT.md in its directory or an ancestor does that — or move the file under an existing fractal; until then no rule can see this reference.
entries.note: Creating a fractal (INTENT.md) or moving a file sets a module boundary; matches enrich-docs' approval gate (skills/enrich-docs/SKILL.md:37,54). The reference is a finding, not a stop: the graph is judged without it (S3c slice 5).

entries.text: With the user's agreement, give its directory or an ancestor an INTENT.md so a fractal owns it (the enrich-docs skill drafts one), or ask the user where the unit belongs; then create a new plan.
entries.note: U(b). Same consent condition as projectSnapshot.ts unowned-dependency sentence (S6 ruling A31/A32).

entries.text: If nothing uses the unit, ask the user whether to delete it rather than move it.
entries.note: Consent to delete a unit.

entries.text: If the evidence does not settle it, ask the user.
entries.note: Internal vs independent without evidence is a design decision.

entries.text: If no such name is evident, ask the user for one.
entries.note: A name with no evidence (code-placement rule 3).

entries.text: Report it to the user; if the unit needs no public boundary of its own, the user may choose contractIntent "internal", which needs no entry file.
entries.note: Falling back to contractIntent 'internal' gives up a public boundary, a design decision; the plan request has no entry-form field (types/restructure.ts:87-90), so no agent action picks a form. Reads as S if treated as a filid limitation. (?)

entries.text: Ask the user where any leftovers belong, and delete ${} only once it is empty.
entries.note: Leftovers are files filid cannot see (dot-prefixed, symlinks, git-ignored, excluded dirs), so placement has no evidence and may involve user-local files; deletion is already gated on emptiness.

entries.text: If the plan's moves or import edits closed the cycle, fix the imports that close it; if it existed before the plan, report it to the user as pre-existing.
entries.note: Spec: a cycle created by the plan is a design judgment; adopted edges re-judged after S5b. The pre-existing branch is a report only; the code already splits baseline cycles, so that branch could follow the preexisting list instead of agent judgment.

entries.text: Stop without a verdict: no prepared review exists for this branch.
entries.note: The same nextAction names the next action ("Run /filid:cross-review to prepare and seal a review before resolving or revalidating"). Resolve and revalidate abort on `missing` by design (resolve/SKILL.md:37, revalidate/SKILL.md:36).

entries.text: Stop and run /filid:cross-review again; it re-seals the report from the validated opinions without new actor work.
entries.note: Names a concrete next action that needs no new actor work. A sealed state without its report is not `cached` (handlers/prepareReviewArtifacts.ts:108-111), so a new run re-seals it.

entries.text: Ask the user for the comparison base, then retry the same review_state call with baseRef set to it.
entries.note: A base branch name with no conventional evidence (if the PR is unavailable, it may also be an auth problem). A possible pre-step, `git remote set-head origin --auto` then retry once, conflicts with cross-review Step 1 ("do not run git" before prepare) and does not help without a remote. (?)

entries.text: Once, after all prior actors finish, call prepare again with the original arguments to start a new review; if the state goes missing again, stop without a terminal verdict.
entries.note: Designed bounded retry. It names the next action (one non-force prepare) and the terminal after a second failure.

entries.text: If the source changes again, stop without a terminal verdict.
entries.note: Terminal of a designed one-retry loop. The sentence before it names the next action (non-force prepare that reuses validated opinions).

entries.text: Human decision advice requires distinct concrete options.
entries.note: A schema error addressed to the reviewer/verifier actor. It limits how an actor may propose a human decision and hands nothing to a person.

entries.text: Human decision advice requires a reason.
entries.note: Same as row 18: an actor-facing schema constraint, not a call to a person.

entries.text: | Human decision required
entries.note: A boolean label (true when any blocker has attention `human-decision`). It reports a fact and hands nothing to a person.

entries.text: Human decision requests
entries.note: An enum/section label.

entries.text: Missing advice means triage, not a mandatory human decision.
entries.note: Negates a human call: it says outright that missing advice does not require a human.

entries.text: Ask the user to point rule "${}" in .filid/review-rules.json at a regular Markdown file inside the repository.
entries.note: Spec rule: repairing .filid/review-rules.json during a review gets the same protection as source. The correct target file is also a name with no evidence.

entries.text: Ask the user to create ${} or correct rule "${}"'s file in .filid/review-rules.json.
entries.note: Config repair during a review is protected like source (spec rule). The body's content, or the corrected path, is the user's rule decision.

entries.text: Ask the user to rename rule "${}" in .filid/review-rules.json, or list the built-in id in its "replaces" array.
entries.note: Protected config repair (spec rule). Whether the rule should replace the built-in or take a new name is a product decision with no evidence.

entries.text: The only code path that writes to `.claude/rules/` is `syncRuleDocs()` in `src/core/infra/configLoader/loaders/syncRuleDocs.ts`, which is invoked exclusively by the `mcp__plugin_filid_tools__project_setup` `rules-sync` action from the `setup` skill after the user confirms a checkbox selection.
entries.note: Describes the deployment path and the setup skill existing checkbox step; not a call.
